title: Ordinary compact-support projection commutes with coefficient extension
statement: For coefficient systems R and S with their canonical inverse-image identifications, a compatible coefficient homomorphism a:R→S, and a fixed compactification c=(j,p) of f, ordinary derived scalar extension carries the proper-counit/open-tensor projection transformation for R to that for S under the normalized scalar/tensor, scalar/pullback and compact-support mate comparisons. This is the equality displayed in the attached Lean statement, for arbitrary unbounded K and L and arbitrary representative-normalized tensor models. No projection invertibility, quotient flatness, boundedness, completeness, or separated structure morphism is assumed. The operations and comparisons are those of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], with tensor models from [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model]. The scalar/tensor and scalar/pullback comparisons are the canonical derived balancing comparisons, and the support comparison is the mate of coefficient restriction; no invertibility or normalization theorem for a finite field extension is used.

proof.text: For the proper coefficient factor, iterated_mateEquiv_conjugateEquiv and uniqueness of left adjoints identify properComparison with the geometric-adjunction mate of scalarPull inverse. The private leftAdjointUniq_inverse lemma proves the needed conjugacy equation from the Mathlib definitions. Apply the proved categorical tensor_mate_coherence argument to the four tensorators, with the scalar/pullback tensor equation supplied by lem-sf-scalar-pull-tensor-coefficient-coherence. The component equation tensorPullback_eq identifies this counit projection with the exact proper factor used in projectionMap.

Use lem-sf-open-projection-factor-coefficient-change for the open factor including the pullback compositor. This equation has no proper image or proper projection. Both source and target projectionMap components are the proper counit projection followed by proper image of projectionOpenFactor, by openProjection_eq.

Expand comparison_factorization on the two inputs and the two projection components. Naturality of properComparison moves scalar extension of the R-open factor past the proper coefficient mate. Functoriality collects the three maps inside the S-proper image; apply the open equation. Apply the proper equation, then naturality of the S-proper projection in the open coefficient map. Functoriality of the target tensor recombines the coefficient comparison. Associativity gives exactly the displayed original equation. This is the formal pasting calculation, performed directly here to avoid the circular broad definition dependency in the DAG record of projection_scalar_square.

proof_origin.note: Stacks 0E48 proper mate/tensor identity and 0E8I open unit identity, with explicit Lean iterated-mate identification and proper/open pasting. The two unformalized normalized-map verifications are isolated as strictly simpler left-adjoint tensor and open-factor statements. All scalar/geometric mate conjugacy is proved here from Mathlib; no arithmetic reduction or completed coefficient theorem is invoked.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportProjectionCoefficientChange
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (R.ring X))
    (aZ : ProEtaleTensorModel c.Z (R.ring c.Z))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (R.ring Y))
    (bX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (S.ring X))
    (bZ : ProEtaleTensorModel c.Z (S.ring c.Z))
    (bY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (S.ring Y))
    (hR : R.pull (c.i ≫ c.g) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i c.g
      (R.ring Y) (R.ring c.Z) (R.ring X) (R.pull c.g) (R.pull c.i))
    (hS : S.pull (c.i ≫ c.g) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i c.g
      (S.ring Y) (S.ring c.Z) (S.ring X) (S.pull c.g) (S.pull c.i))
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)))
    (L : DerivedCategory (pbcModules Y (R.ring Y))) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).map
        (((projectionMap R c aX aZ aY hR).app K).app L) ≫
      (comparison a c).app (aX.tensor.obj (K, (pull R f).obj L)) ≫
      (image S c).map ((scalarTensor (a.map X) aX bX).hom.app
        (K, (pull R f).obj L) ≫
        bX.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ((scalarPull a f).hom.app L))) =
    (scalarTensor (a.map Y) aY bY).hom.app ((image R c).obj K, L) ≫
      bY.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((comparison a c).app K) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      (((projectionMap S c bX bZ bY hS).app
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map X)).obj K)).app
          ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).obj L))

old_proof.text: For the proper factor transpose both routes under the target geometric adjunction. The coefficient mate counit equation and the compatibility of scalar and geometric tensor comparisons identify their transposes; this compatibility is checked on flat-term K-flat representatives by the same sectionwise balancing formula on pure tensors. Extend through the resolving localization.

For the open factor transpose through extension by zero and restriction. Both normalized composites restrict to the tensor identity on the open and vanish off it. Invert the known open projection isomorphisms. Paste with the proper equation, expand comparison_factorization, and use naturality and pullback-composition coherence. This gives the displayed equation for the actual compactification projection.
